reasons: Directionally correct: p0012 imposes a USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay with no reduction or termination rights, so Customer pays the full remaining contract value regardless of consumption — functionally a Customer-payable minimum fee/penalty, which the rule's detection guidance (minimum fees, LDs payable by Customer) and walk-away position (LDs exceeding remaining contract value) capture.

Redline reaches the preferred position by deleting the Customer-payable commitment and, consistent with the redline guidance and fallback, caps any early-termination fee at three months' Fees as the sole liquidated amount; the added anti-LD sentence is protective and does not create counterparty-favourable ambiguity.

The failed minimal-edit check (ratio 0.866) is expected here: the rule requires removal of the entire take-or-pay obligation, so a whole-clause replacement is the smallest edit that achieves the playbook position.
Comment is accurate, in the required voice and prefix, explains the change, cites the internal conflicts (Sections 7.1 and 12.3) relied on in the rationale, and states the fallback without lecturing.
